title: DelegateCapsuleResult
description: Fixed parent envelope. Completed results have file-backed supplementary notes; every failed branch has mandatory expanded inline notes. No result type checker.

result.description: Flash's JSON answer passed through unchanged, without validation against output_example.

notes_path.description: Absolute retained supplementary-notes file path. Optional; omit when no notes exist. Never inline notes or invented paths. Runtime checks readability.

raw_history.description: Absolute readable transcript path supplied by the plugin. Never transcript text, encoded bytes, URI, or session ID. Runtime checks existence after retention.

notes.description: Mandatory inline explanation: cause, established partial outcome, and needed action. Never substitute notes_path. Required even if storage fails.

raw_history.description: Absolute retained readable partial-transcript path when available; otherwise omit. Never contents, placeholders, or null.
